page.layout: One page of text, single column; running head at top with page number at top right; a woodcut ornament band and a large headed title (HOMILIA / tertia) above the main text; signature mark "c. iiij" at the foot right, below the last line.

main_text.p: optimum Patrem & Seruatorem nostrum precemur, vt quum nobis oculos aperuerit ad istiusmodi blasphemas abominationes agno-scendas & detcstādas,nos etiām magis ac magis ad veritatis notitiam conformet, vt vera viuáque & sincera fide prẹditi,salutis illius ę-ternæ tandem participes fiamus, & reliquum vitæ nostræ curriculum, per Sp. S. veri eiusi-mi᷑atores facti transfigamus.
main_text.head: HOMILIA tertia.
main_text.p: VELLEM, fratres, paucioribus à nobis initio proposita capita possent explicari, antequam ad huius historiæ contextum accedamus: sed difficultates occurrentes eæ sunt vt satis enodari non possint: tantáque ad nos inde redit vtilitas, vt de iis nunquam satis cogitari possit. Peruenimus autem ad quartum & vltimum caput, finem nimirum ad quem hæc omnia referenda sunt, vt fructum ex iis percipiamus. Hic verò commodè potest ad tria capita referri,quorum primum est, Patefactio gloriæ Dei longè maior

page.notes: Woodcut ornament above the heading is not text. The large initial V is a woodcut letter, read as V. The opening word "VELLEM" is set in small capitals after the initial. Marks such as "mi᷑atores" are doubtful and read as printed; "prẹditi" and "ę-ternæ" have uncertain diacritics. The signature "c. iiij" is at the foot right and is recorded in bottom_margin.
